name: OSS_RMCS_DOC_SUB_LINES_T
description: This table stores RMCS source document sub lines data.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of a source document type in Oracle Revenue Management Cloud

columns.name: DOC_LINE_ID_INT_1
columns.description: First numeric column of the key that identifies source document line in source application.

columns.name: DOC_LINE_ID_CHAR_2
columns.description: Second character column of the key that identifies source document line in source application.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: PROCESSED_FLAG
columns.description: Flaf represents whether records are processed or not.

columns.name: SATISFACTION_EVENT_PERCENT
columns.description: Used to derive the percent of a satisfaction event when the satisfaction measurement model is Measure Percentage Satisfied.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
